title: Honeybee performance workload record
description: One measurable workload: what runs, how it is driven, what is measured, what is ruled. Machine-readable inventory; the sibling <id>.md holds interpretation.

id.description: Stable slug. Changing the measured population or fixture creates a new id or a new baseline series, never a silent overwrite.

lane.description: startup: launch to usable. interaction: one input to its effect. streaming: continuous delivery to a visible surface. steady-state: idle or background work with no input. throughput: rate or backlog under load. memory: retention and peaks. lifecycle: acquire/hide/resume/release cycles. recovery: disconnect, restart, resync. dev-loop: developer wait, never shipped-app performance.

owners.description: Source paths that implement the measured path. The census records their blob hashes so drift can be detected.

verificationFeatures.description: verify-apiary feature ids that drive the same user path.

user.description: What the user observes when the workload completes.

assertions.description: Correctness checks that must hold on every sample; a sample that fails one is not a timing sample.

key.description: Census key this workload accounts for, e.g. command:view.open, view:hive.agent-list, ipc:hive:list, socket:apiaryd, timer:memoryLedger.ts:41.

shared.description: Present when another workload measures the same implementation; states why coverage is shared.

accounts.description: Every census entry must be accounted for by some workload, or listed in workloads/gaps.json with a reason.

why.description: Why the state matters, or why it does not. Required either way so an omission is a decision, not a default.

states.description: Which lifecycle states this workload measures. Unmeasured-but-relevant states are gaps, not omissions.

preset.description: control-apiary fixture preset or benchmark fixture name.

contentKey.description: Fixture content identity as the driver reports it; comparisons across keys are rejected.

driver.description: Script that owns launch, capture and cleanup, e.g. apps/desktop/scripts/control-apiary.mjs.

command.description: Exact invocation. Environment pins (Node) are the skill's, not the record's.

scenario.description: Scenario JSON path when the driver takes one.

readiness.description: Observable that starts the measured interval.

reset.description: How state is returned between samples.

serial.description: true when no other timing workload may run concurrently on the host.

scope.description: Process or transport the number belongs to, e.g. renderer, main+apiaryd, renderer->main, apiaryd<->hived, wire.

collector.description: What produces the number: user-timing mark, boot report, memory ledger, CDP trace, inspector profile, transport counter, OS tool.

kind.description: Sampled peaks are lower bounds. Input-to-observed-DOM is an upper bound on the user-visible effect. Payload sizes computed without serializing are estimates. Wire bytes from the transport are actual.

status.description: gap: named, no collector or no reproducible path. recipe-only: command exists, never run to a retained receipt. measured: receipt exists for current owners. stale: owners changed since the receipt. gated: a test or CI step asserts it. These are states, not a ladder: gated is not stronger evidence than measured, and stale is not worse than gap.

invariant.description: Scaling or work-count assertion when a fixed number is wrong, e.g. 'rows decoded == 0 for registry-only updates'.

noise.description: Known variability and what controls it.

gap.description: Why the metric cannot be collected yet, when status is gap.

collectorProtocol.description: How the collector ran. Required for sampled or trace collectors once measured; free-form keys allowed, these are the recognised ones.

visibility.description: Document visibility during capture. Hidden windows cannot establish foreground presentation.

throttling.description: Background throttling policy requested; the boot mark records what applied.

maxGapMs.description: Largest gap between two samples; peaks inside a gap are unobserved.

probes.description: Probe set enabled, e.g. cdp-metrics, trace, cpu-profile, heap-sampling, process-census.

captureOverhead.description: Evidence of collector cost, e.g. captureDurationMs per sample or a no-probe control run.

incompleteSamples.description: Samples with missing rows, e.g. a process the census could not read.

states.description: Which of the workload states this metric is collected in. A relevant workload state no metric lists is an unmeasured state, visible in the index.

betterWhen.description: Which direction is an improvement. Required for regression detection; units never decide it (a count can be a cost or a hit rate).

why.description: Which displaced cost the linked workload catches, e.g. startup precompute vs first-use.

gaps.description: Known measurement limits at workload level, stated plainly.

readiness.description: One sentence from the agent on what this record can and cannot show today. The index reports per-metric status counts; there is no scalar rollup because gap, stale and gated are not ordered.

status.description: ruled: operator ruling, only the operator changes it. advisory: a ruled or historical number reported for context, never failed on. proposed: an agent suggestion awaiting ruling. Independent of the metric status enum, which describes coverage.

source.description: Document and date of the ruling or proposal.

condition.description: Hardware, fixture, and state the budget assumes.

seriesId.description: Identity of fixture + collector protocol (probe set, scheduling, visibility, throttling) + machine + runtime + build mode. A change to any of them starts a new series; series are never compared.

receipt.description: Path to the compact JSON receipt under docs/performance/ or an archive coordinate.

p95.description: Only when samples justify it; small startup sets do not.

hostLoad.description: Load average or equivalent at capture; high load makes the receipt recipe proof, not comparative timing.

runtime.description: Pinned runtime identity, e.g. node v24.18.0, electron 3x.y.z.

probes.description: Probe set active during the receipt; part of the series identity.

aggregation.description: Aggregation of `aggregate`; must match the metric's aggregation for check to compare.

aggregate.description: The baseline value under `aggregation`. `median` and `p95` remain as descriptive fields.

baseline.description: The measured aggregate for the current owners. A baseline is a receipt, never a verdict; pass/fail against a budget is produced by `perf-map check` from a receipt and is not stored here.
